ايقاف الوحدة 
 تماما والتنسيق مع قسم التشغيل لتنفيذ الاحتياطات المطلوبة 
 والمدونة بامر الشغل للمسخن الغازى للوحدة رقم (2) مع اتباع 
 تعليمات الامن والسلامة المنصوص عليها والخاصة بعزل المسخن

التأكد من وصول درجة حرارة المسخن الى الدرجة المناسبة لبدء 
 الاعمال وهى حرارة 60م

يتم 
 غسيل المسخن الغازى كيميائيا قبل البدء فى تنفيذ الاعمال 
 بمحلول كيميائى بدرجة حرارة مناسبة لدرجة حرارة المسخن لتجنب 
 الاجهادات الحرارية على معدن المسخن اثناء الغسيل

يتم 
 فتح بوابة التفتيش اعلى المسخن اسفل المدخنة ثم يتم الدخول 
 للمسخن اعلى سلات باسكت المنطقة الباردة ويتم اخلاء سلات احدى 
 قطاعات شرائح الصاج لاتاحة الفرصة للكشف على طرفى القطاع

فحص 
 وصلات التمدد من حيث عدم وجود تأكل داخل اجزاء المسخن فى هذه 
 المنطقة

يتم 
 عمل سقالة اسفل الصاج الساخن داخل المسخن للكشف على جسم المسخن 
 ووصلات التمدد

يتم 
 الكشف على خلوصات المسهن والوصلات المرنة والتأكد من صلاحيتها 
 للعمل

عند الكشف تبين بدء تآكل فى الاماكن 
 الاتية:
Cold side 
 radial seal sector 
 والمكون من قطاعين وجزء اوسط حول العمود والتأكل موجود عند 
 الاطراف والمنطقة الوسطى والجانب الاخر من القطاع وبدأ يقل 
 السمك عن 10 مم مما يدل عل عدم امكانية استمراره فى العمل لمدة 
 6 اشهر اخرى مما يستلزم استبداله بآخر جديد

تم تبديل الـ 
radial seal sector 
 كاملا

عند فك الاجزاء الجانبية 
(Seal air frame)
 والمسئول عن 
(Axial seal)
يتم الاتى:
 - تبديل 
The axial seal 
 jacket
 - 
 ضبط الخلوصات المحورية من الجانبين
 - 
 تم تغيير الشدادات ووصلات التمدد الخاصة بالمسخن بعد الانتهاء 
 من الاعمال السابقة

تم 
 تصنيع اجزاء من
Cold 
 side cover grates 
 وتصميمها تحت اشراف قسم صيانة الغلايات 
بورش المحطة

تم 
 تركيب وصلات تمدد لمممر الغازات اسفل المسخن الغازى بدلا من 
 الاجزاء التالفة

بعد 
 استكمال الاعمال الخاصة بالمسخن وضبط قيم الخلوصات المسموح بها 
 تم عمل اختبار تشغيل المسخن الغازى
(Run 
 test) 
 للتأكد من ظروف التشغيل الطبيعية للمسخن قبل ادخالة بالخدمة 
 الفعلية

sections_en.text: Since several years have passed since the replacement and renewal of the unit, the boiler maintenance department carries out periodic inspections of the gas air heater at each periodic maintenance, every 6 months, and inspection showed the start of damage and corrosion in various places of the air heater and the insulation areas (the upper sector separating the air and gas paths).
Replacement of the radial seal sector and axial sealing jacket of the air pre-heater

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Wael Abdel Razek Sayed, tested by Eng. Romany Naguib, approved by Eng. Mostafa Zahran, and endorsed by Eng. Hussein Ahmed Ahmed, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at Assiut Steam.
Isolate the equipment on which maintenance is to be carried out
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their occupational safety and health categories
Define the work area of the gas air heater and place warning signs indicating that work is being carried out
Workers must wear the necessary industrial safety and safety equipment while carrying out the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes

rows: Shut down the unit completely and coordinate with the operations department to implement the required precautions recorded in the work order for the unit No. (2) gas air heater, following the safety instructions for isolating the air heater
Verify that the air heater temperature has reached the suitable temperature to start work, namely 60 °C

Chemically wash the gas air heater before starting work, using a chemical solution at a temperature suitable for the air heater temperature to avoid thermal stresses on the air heater metal during washing

Open the inspection door at the top of the air heater below the stack, then enter the air heater above the cold-zone basket sector and empty the baskets of one of the sheet-metal sectors to allow inspection of both ends of the sector
Inspect the expansion joints for absence of corrosion inside the air heater parts in this area
Erect a scaffold below the hot sheet inside the air heater to inspect the air heater body and the expansion joints
Inspect the air heater clearances and the flexible connections and verify they are fit for service

On inspection, corrosion was found to have started in the following places: Cold side radial seal sector, consisting of two sectors and a middle part around the shaft; the corrosion is at the ends, the middle area and the other side of the sector, and the thickness has begun to fall below 10 mm, indicating that it cannot continue in service for another 6 months, so it must be replaced with a new one
The complete radial seal sector was replaced

When dismantling the side parts (Seal air frame) responsible for the (Axial seal), the following was done: - Replace the axial seal jacket - Adjust the axial clearances on both sides - The tie rods and the air heater expansion joints were changed after completion of the previous work
Parts of the cold side cover grates were manufactured and designed under the supervision of the boiler maintenance department at the station workshops
Expansion joints were fitted for the gas passage below the gas air heater in place of the damaged parts

After completing the air heater work and adjusting the permitted clearance values, a run test of the gas air heater was carried out to verify the normal operating conditions of the air heater before putting it into actual service

Since several years have passed since the replacement and renewal of the unit, the boiler maintenance department carries out periodic inspections of the gas air heater at each periodic maintenance, every 6 months, and inspection showed the start of damage and corrosion in various places of the air heater and the insulation areas (the upper sector separating the air and gas paths).
Replacement of the radial seal sector and axial sealing jacket of the air pre-heater
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Wael Abdel Razek Sayed, tested by Eng. Romany Naguib, approved by Eng. Mostafa Zahran, and endorsed by Eng. Hussein Ahmed Ahmed, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at Assiut Steam.

Define the work area of the gas air heater and place warning signs indicating that work is being carried out
Workers must wear the necessary industrial safety and safety equipment while carrying out the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes

Inspect the expansion joints for absence of corrosion inside the air heater parts in this area | 5.
Erect a scaffold below the hot sheet inside the air heater to inspect the air heater body and the expansion joints | 6.
Inspect the air heater clearances and the flexible connections and verify they are fit for service | 7.
On inspection, corrosion was found to have started in the following places: Cold side radial seal sector, consisting of two sectors and a middle part around the shaft; the corrosion is at the ends, the middle area and the other side of the sector, and the thickness has begun to fall below 10 mm, indicating that it cannot continue in service for another 6 months, so it must be replaced with a new one | 8.
The complete radial seal sector was replaced | 9.
When dismantling the side parts (Seal air frame) responsible for the (Axial seal), the following was done: - Replace the axial seal jacket - Adjust the axial clearances on both sides - The tie rods and the air heater expansion joints were changed after completion of the previous work | 10
Parts of the cold side cover grates were manufactured and designed under the supervision of the boiler maintenance department at the station workshops | 11.
Expansion joints were fitted for the gas passage below the gas air heater in place of the damaged parts | 12.
